name: automatic-stale-same-worktree-owner-takeover
title: Automatically hand off stale same-worktree ownership only in non-code phases with no owner command in flight
description: For a stale foreign Story lease in the same canonical worktree and host, automatically hand off ownership only for storyScopedMutating commands in PLAN, REVIEW, or TEST, through an atomic single-winner transaction when both sessions have stable supported identities and the recorded last mutating CLI process is mechanically absent. DEV, dangerousMutating, agent_prompt direct acquisition, malformed, active, remote, different-worktree, derived-identity, live/unknown/EPERM states remain manual or fail-closed. A durable Story process-event records handoff authorization before lease publication; the existing convergence takeover counter remains the sole operational counter and is reconciled idempotently through a pending transfer id before any command proceeds.
